thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that India's lack of prosperity stems from government interference and protectionism that prevent the nation from focusing on areas where it has a distinct competitive advantage, citing Adam Smith's 'The Wealth of Nations' as the foundational text for this economic principle. He illustrates this by contrasting the inefficient, government-protected sugar cane industry in Uttar Pradesh with the naturally optimized shrimp farming industry in Andhra Pradesh, suggesting that free market capitalism would allow resources to shift to more productive uses.
